items.title: Unit 1 · Story
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.storyText: It is winter. Kate and her dad skate on a lake. My cane is new. My skates are old. Look. My name is on the gate. Your name is on the cave, too. And your name is on the cake! New skates!
items.why: In “Kate's Skates”, you hear: My cane is new. The missing word is “cane”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 3, Unit 1, p.11 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
